authorization: The user approved the stronger follow-up protocol and a 500-credit ceiling before dispatch.

verification_procedure.oracle: Apply each retained patch to the tracked base snapshot, then run the independent five-scenario oracle and empty-PATH oracle.
verification_procedure.immutable_suite: Run the tracked base tests against the patched candidate installer.
verification_procedure.candidate_suite: Run the candidate-authored tests against the patched candidate installer.
verification_procedure.mutation_suite: Run the candidate-authored tests against the tracked broken base installer; only a FAIL assertion counts as BEHAVIORAL_ASSERTION, while setup or missing-helper failures are HARNESS_ERROR.
verification_procedure.syntax: Run bash -n separately on the candidate installer and candidate test file.

promotion_rule: Promote only if GPT-6.1 has three valid coding passes, is no worse than GPT-5.6 on gate adherence, and has no correctness, scope, regression-test, or human-correction regression. Any split or incomplete result keeps the incumbent.
